Every session running the bundle publishes a heartbeat"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" to a local registry under `~/.dsh/crosstalk/` (files + atomic rename, no daemon — if two sessions c"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"an see the same home directory, they can message). Each session gets a stable name (`<repo-or-cwd-sl"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ug>-<adjective>`, e.g. `dsh-cowork-amber`) plus a durable ref id; any session can list the live ones"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" and send a message that arrives in the target as a **clearly-labeled turn** — `[message from sessio"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"n dsh-cowork-amber (/Users/me/projects/dsh-cowork)]` — with the sender's name riding along, so reply"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"ing is just `send_message` back."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this shape"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH ships `send_message` and `list_agents`, but strictly hierarchical: a parent messages its own bac"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"kground subagents. Sibling sessions — two DSH sessions in different repos on the same machine — cann"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ot see or message each other. Multi-session workflows (one session per repo, a coordinator farming w"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ork out, a routine pinging a live session, a chatnode human-in-the-loop peer) all need the missing p"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"rimitive: horizontal messaging. dsh-crosstalk copies Claude Code's model — `ListAgents` shows every "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"live local session; `SendMessage` addresses any of them by name — onto DSH's existing tool names, so"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" the tools you already know gain a `peers` scope and peer addressing without a second vocabulary."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Identity** — at start, the session derives `<slug>-<adjective>` from its working directory plus"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" a process-unique ref (`ct-…`). Same cwd, two sessions → different adjectives, distinct names; the r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ef disambiguates and is what inbox paths use.
2. **Registry** — one heartbeat JSON file per live ses"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"sion under `<home>/registry/<ref>.json` (`name`, `ref`, `pid`, `cwd`, `status`, `startedAt`, `heartb"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"eatAt`, `uid`, `inbox`). Refreshed on a timer; entries with no beat for 2× the interval are shown as"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" dead and garbage-collected (heartbeat file + orphan inbox removed).
3. **Tools — extend, don't dupl"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"icate**:
- `list_agents` gains `scope: peers` (other live sessions on this machine: name, status, cw"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"d, last activity) and `scope: all` (descendants + peers). The stock children/descendants scopes are "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"delegated to the captured stock definition.
- `send_message` accepts a peer name or ref in `to` alon"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"gside subagent ids, with an optional `summary` (5–10 word recap shown in the target UI).
- The stock"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" tools stay registered; this bundle shadows them **per agent** (scoped registrations are reversible "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"Cordis effects), so unloading cleanly restores stock behavior exactly.
4. **Delivery** — the message"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" is one JSON file appended to the target's inbox (`<home>/inbox/<ref>/`), written atomically (temp f"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ile + rename), so a crash mid-write is never observed as a partial message. The target's watcher pol"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"ls its inbox and injects each accepted message into the live session via `followup`: **an idle targe"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"t wakes for a turn; a busy target receives it at the next turn boundary**. Delivery is best-effort —"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" `list_agents` status is not a delivery promise.
5. **Injection** — the turn is labeled `[message fr"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"om session <name> (<cwd>)]` and carries a `crosstalk` source (`form: relay`), so the append-only log"},{"id":"p8s19","text":" records provenance by construction and the DSH UI renders it as a labeled relay card — never as use"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"r text.
